text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key idea is responsive design, which means apps should work well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps work on several, saving time and money. After building an app, developers publish it on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot. Users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly. If an app is slow or crashes often, people will delete it and choose a better option.
